household.thermostat: Nest in hallway; keep 19C, do not turn below 12C

pets.name: Barsik
pets.feeding: 40g dry in the morning ONLY; no treats (diet)
pets.litter: Scoop every 2 days, spare bags under sink
pets.quirks: Hides under bed from strangers - do not chase, shake treat bag
pets.emergency_note: If not eating >24h - call owner first

trash.note: Bins out Monday evening, bring in Wednesday

mail: Hold at post office, small slot - nothing accumulates
quirks: Back door needs LIFT-then-turn or it sticks
Boiler pilot sometimes cuts out - reset switch behind white panel, hold 5s
Kitchen faucet drips if not pushed fully left

shutoffs.water_main: Under kitchen sink, red lever, turn clockwise
shutoffs.electricity: Breaker box in hallway closet, main switch top-left
shutoffs.gas: Yellow valve behind stove - DO NOT touch, call 555-0199

escalation.do: Close water main, call Denis, then plumber
Reset boiler (quirks list). If fails: electric heaters in hall closet, open under-sink cabinets, call Denis
Call vet, then Denis. Spend limit 500 before calling

spending_rule: Up to 100 for anything urgent, keep receipts
key_location: Lockbox attached to gas meter, code given verbally
